newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi share index edges up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi share index edges up in thin trade.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index edged up on Friday on gains to key shares, brokers said.
The index gained 15.05 points to close at 3303.89. Turnover was 8.277 million shillings ($150,000) on 189,240 shares compared to 8.228 million shillings on Wednesday.
"There were a lot of buy orders but very little supply," a senior broker said. He said investors were reluctant to sell at current prices as they felt they were still too low.
The market is more than 25 percent off its record high and trading this week has been subdued in very thin volumes.
"If prices continue to climb like this, maybe they might attract sellers," another broker said.
Barclays Bank gained two shillings to close at 110 while foreign demand for Kenya Commercial Bank pushed it up to close at 87.50 from 86. Standard Chartered Bank eased to 45 from 45.25.
Uchumi Supermarket rose to 41 from 39 while Kenya Airways closed at 8.50 from 8.40. Nation Printers & Publishers gained a shilling to close at 161.
Rea Vipingo Plantations gained 60 cents to close at 9.00 while Sasini Tea & Coffee was unchanged at 76.
Kenya Power & Lighting was unchanged at 124 while Kenya Breweries closed at 58.50, unchanged.
